data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'silvanos', meaning 'forest dweller'. In ancient Greece, Silvanus was the god of the forest and wild places. In Christianity, Silvanos is a male given name of Greek origin. The name Silvanos carries the meaning “Forest dweller” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek. Parents who choose Silvanos usually hope their child will grow to embody forest dweller and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Silvanos total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: סילואנוס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו הוא ששייך ליער או יער שופע חיים. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'סילבנוס' שפירושה יער. השם מופיע בברית החדשה ומתייחס לאדם ששמו סילבנוס, שכנראה היה נוצרי בראשית הנצרות.

in_greek.name: Σιλβανός
in_greek.meaning: Ανήκει στο δάσος ή το δάσος που ευδοκιμεί στη ζωή
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Σιλβανός είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από το ελληνικό και σημαίνει ότι ανήκει στο δάσος ή το δάσος που ευδοκιμεί στη ζωή. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'Σιλβανός' που σημαίνει δάσος. Το όνομα εμφανίζεται στη Καινή Διαθήκη και αναφέρεται σε ένα πρόσωπο με το όνομα Σιλβανός, που πιθανότατα ήταν χριστιανός στις αρχές του Χριστιανισμού.

In Christian tradition, the name Silvanos is associated with qualities such as strength, resilience, and adaptability.

biblical_reference.note: The name Silvanos appears in the New Testament as a companion of Peter and Paul.

historical_references.reference: Silvanos was a name given to certain early Christian saints, believed to have been martyred during the reign of Emperor Hadrian (117-138 AD) in Italy. The name Silvanos may have been chosen because it was similar to the name of the Roman god Silvanus, and was thus intended to confuse or distract their persecutors.
historical_references.context: Roman Empire, Italy, Christian martyrs, Roman god Silvanus

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Silvanos comes from the Acts of Silvanus, a late 4th century hagiography that recounts the life and martyrdom of a bishop named Silvanus in the region of Lycaonia in Anatolia (modern-day Turkey). The text describes Silvanus as being a Roman soldier who converted to Christianity and was subsequently martyred during the reign of Emperor Decius (249-251 AD).
historical_references.context: Anatolia, Late Roman Empire, Roman soldier, Christian martyr, Emperor Decius

It is popular in Neopagan and Nature-based spirituality circles, especially among those who follow Wicca and other earth-centered belief systems. Silvanos is frequently invoked in rituals, prayers and spells relating to the natural world, growth, and protection. The name can be found on various social media platforms such as Reddit, Facebook, and Instagram, where communities and individuals share information, resources, and experiences related to Silvanos and other similar deities. On Reddit, the subreddit /r/Silvanus is an active community for those interested in the god and his associated practices. On Facebook, there are various groups dedicated to Silvanos and his cult. On Instagram, users often post images of nature, altars, and other aspects of their spiritual practices in honor of Silvanos and other forest deities.
